business_summary: Guang Dong Qun Xing Toys Joint-Stockco.,Ltd. engages in the sales of alcohol in China. It also engages in intelligent computing services, alcohol sales, and property leasing and management services. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Suzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Guang Dong Qun Xing Toys Joint-Stockco.,Ltd. engages in the sales of alcohol in China. 또한 지능형 컴퓨팅 서비스, 주류 판매, 부동산 임대 및 관리 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1996년에 설립되었으며 중국 쑤저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
